stories.title: Migrant crisis on Spanish-Moroccan border triggers diplomatic tensions
stories.summary: Spain faces fresh questions over migration after as many as 60,000 migrants entered Spanish territory this week from Morocco. Most have now returned.

stories.title: France's famed Bordeaux wine country has been charred by wildfire
stories.summary: Southwest France has seen wildfires in the past. But the fires that raged last week and scorched 100,000 acres are something new to the region.

stories.title: Phoenix sears under sweltering heat
stories.summary: Much of the western U-S is facing dangerously high temperatures this weekend. Phoenix is expecting highs above 110 degrees. And public cooling centers are seeing high demand.

stories.title: Police shooting in Madison, Wis. sparks renewed calls for officers to wear body cams
stories.summary: Police in Madison, Wisconsin don't widely use body cameras. That policy is under renewed scrutiny following the recent shooting death of a 38-year-old Black man at the hands of police.

stories.title: How one man's love of flyfishing carried him through tough times
stories.summary: An avid fly fisherman in Vermont shares his love of the craft and how its shaped his mental health journey.

stories.title: Viral 'Teen Takeover' trend is causing trouble in some communities
stories.summary: Communities across the country are dealing with "Teen Takeovers" this summer. The viral social media trend is causing disruptions in public spaces across the country. Teens in Charlotte weigh in.
